title: Part 7 Đơn • Bộ 05: Chat Hỗ trợ Khách sạn & Thông báo Cải tạo Vườn Bách thảo
subtitle: Thực chiến tin nhắn dịch vụ khách sạn (Chat) và thông báo tham quan công cộng (Notice).
tips: Mẹo Part 7: Khi gặp câu hỏi suy luận về thời gian hoặc chi phí trong tin nhắn CSKH, hãy chú ý các từ giới hạn như "complimentary" (miễn phí), "every thirty minutes" (30 phút/chuyến), và "prior to" (trước khi).

meta.title: Grand Harbor Hotel — Concierge Live Chat
meta.subtitle: Guest Support Thread • November 2

messages.text: Hello! I have a reservation under Ortiz for tomorrow night. My flight lands at 9:15 A.M., and I was wondering if early check-in is possible.
Welcome, Ms. Ortiz! Standard check-in starts at 3:00 P.M., but I have noted your early arrival. If a deluxe room is ready by 10:30 A.M., we will gladly check you in at no extra charge.
Thank you! And what if the room isn’t ready yet? I have a client lunch nearby at noon.
Our bell desk can securely store your luggage for free, and you are welcome to freshen up in the third-floor fitness lounge.
Perfect! One last question—does the hotel run an airport shuttle?
Yes, our complimentary shuttle departs Terminal B every thirty minutes on the hour and half-hour. Just show your booking confirmation to the driver.

meta.title: WILLOW CREEK BOTANICAL CONSERVATORY — RENOVATION UPDATE
meta.subtitle: Visitor Information • April 1 through May 15

paragraphs: Beginning April 1, the historic Glass Palm Dome at Willow Creek Botanical Conservatory will undergo roof restoration to replace aging iron frames and upgrade humidity controls. For visitor safety, the Palm Dome will be closed to the public through May 15.

All other areas of the conservatory—including the Orchid Pavilion, the Desert Succulent House, the outdoor Rose Gardens, and the gift shop—will remain open during regular hours (9:00 A.M. to 6:00 P.M. daily). Guided walking tours of the Rose Gardens will depart from the West Gate at 11:00 A.M. and 2:00 P.M.

Because the main dome is temporarily unavailable, general admission tickets are discounted by 25 percent throughout the restoration period. Annual conservatory members will receive two complimentary guest passes valid through August 31 as a thank-you for their continued support.

questions.q: Why did Ms. Ortiz contact the hotel concierge?
opts: To change the dates of her hotel reservation
To ask about early arrival arrangements and airport transport
To book a private dining room for a client lunch
To report a lost suitcase at Terminal B
questions.exp: Ms. Ortiz nhắn hỏi 2 nội dung chính: khả năng nhận phòng sớm ("if early check-in is possible") và xe đưa đón sân bay ("does the hotel run an airport shuttle?"). Chọn (B). Loại (A), (C), (D).

questions.q: At 2:17 P.M., what does Ms. Ortiz imply by writing "Perfect!"?
opts: She is satisfied with the backup options for storing luggage and getting ready.
She has decided to cancel her noon lunch with her client.
She prefers to pay extra for a suite on the third floor.
She has already boarded the hotel shuttle at Terminal B.
questions.exp: Ngay trước lúc 2:17 P.M., Samir gợi ý giải pháp nếu phòng chưa sẵn sàng: quầy hành lý giữ đồ miễn phí và khách có thể chỉnh trang tại phòng chờ tầng 3 trước bữa trưa với khách hàng. Ms. Ortiz đáp "Perfect!" thể hiện sự hài lòng với phương án dự phòng này. Chọn (A).

questions.q: What must Ms. Ortiz show to use the airport shuttle?
opts: Her flight boarding pass
A fitness lounge membership card
Her hotel booking confirmation
A paper ticket purchased at Terminal B
questions.exp: Tin nhắn cuối lúc 2:18 P.M. nêu rõ: "Just show your booking confirmation to the driver" (chỉ cần xuất trình xác nhận đặt phòng cho tài xế, xe hoàn toàn miễn phí). Chọn (C). Loại (A), (B), (D).

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the notice?
opts: To inform visitors about partial closures and discounted entry during repairs
To recruit volunteers to plant new roses along the West Gate
To announce permanent changes to daily closing hours
To advertise a private charity concert inside the Palm Dome
questions.exp: Thông báo nêu khu Glass Palm Dome đóng cửa cải tạo mái (1/4–15/5), các khu khác vẫn mở bình thường và vé vào cổng được giảm giá 25% trong suốt thời gian sửa chữa. Chọn (A). Loại (B), (C), (D).

questions.q: Which area of the conservatory will be CLOSED from April 1 through May 15?
opts: The Orchid Pavilion
The Glass Palm Dome
The Desert Succulent House
The outdoor Rose Gardens
questions.exp: Đoạn 1 ghi rõ: "the Palm Dome will be closed to the public through May 15", còn đoạn 2 xác nhận Orchid Pavilion, Desert Succulent House và Rose Gardens đều mở cửa bình thường. Chọn (B).

questions.q: Where do guided tours of the Rose Gardens begin?
opts: At the gift shop entrance
Inside the Orchid Pavilion
At the West Gate
Outside the Palm Dome
questions.exp: Câu cuối đoạn 2 nêu: "Guided walking tours of the Rose Gardens will depart from the West Gate at 11:00 A.M. and 2:00 P.M." Chọn (C).

questions.q: What special benefit is being offered to annual conservatory members?
opts: Free access to the Palm Dome during roof repairs
A 25 percent discount at the conservatory gift shop
A complimentary six-month membership extension
Two free guest passes usable until the end of August
questions.exp: Câu cuối đoạn 3 viết: "Annual conservatory members will receive two complimentary guest passes valid through August 31" ("complimentary" ↔ "free", "through August 31" ↔ "until the end of August"). Chọn (D). Lưu ý mức giảm 25% áp dụng cho vé vào cổng thường (general admission), không phải cửa hàng quà tặng.

paraphrases.text: at no extra charge / for free / complimentary
paraphrases.vi: không tính thêm phí / miễn phí ↔ miễn phí
trải qua đợt phục hồi mái ↔ trong thời gian sửa chữa

paraphrases.answer: usable until the end of August
paraphrases.vi: có giá trị hết ngày 31/8 ↔ sử dụng được tới cuối tháng 8
khởi hành từ Cổng Tây ↔ bắt đầu tại Cổng Tây
